summary: REPAIR ROUND 1 of TASK-006 (repair_rounds_used 0 -> 1), fixing the three live findings from independent review 8a402362 plus LOW-4. Changed exactly two files, both in allowed_paths: src/stores/queueStore.ts (449 -> 576 lines) and src/hooks/useImageGeneratorExecution.ts (99 -> 119 lines). No scripts/**, no imageGenerationExecution.ts, no .workflow-kit/**, no src-tauri/**; scope check reports outside=[] and protected=[]. FINDING 1 (REQ-001 user-visible symptom survived): flowStore is not persisted so recovery's clearing write was a no-op, while the surviving copy is the persisted canvasStore and updateNodeQueuedState returned early for the active canvas; App.tsx:154 setNodes then reloaded the stale queued=true which ImageGeneratorNode canRun reads. Fix: updateNodeQueuedState replaced by clearNodeQueuedMarker which clears BOTH carriers (flowStore + the persisted canvas copy), clear-only, field-level against current state so it cannot clobber the 800ms canvas debounce or other node fields, idempotent, and with a null-canvasId fallback to the active canvas (a real remaining hole, since the executor resolves null-canvas jobs against the active canvas); it is used by all three clear paths (recovery, cancel, enqueue-rejection). waitForCanvasReady no longer returns on _hasHydrated alone: it now requires _hasHydrated AND every node resolvable, and selects the copy by 'is this the active canvas' instead of 'does flowStore happen to contain this id' (the latter is wrong under duplicated canvases, which preserve node.id). Recovery additionally re-checks after dispatch via clearNodeQueuedMarkerIfIdle, which skips when a queued job legitimately exists so it cannot erase a marker for a generation the user just started in that window. FINDING 2 (guard introduced a NEW permanent lock reachable by ordinary clicking - most severe): enqueue returned '' on rejection but both callers ignored it and unconditionally wrote {queued:true,status:'idle'}, and the executor clears queued only at job START, so a rejection arriving after the last job started left the flag forever with no active job to clear it (restart does not help: the flag lives in the persisted canvas copy and the queue holds no queued job). Fix on both sides: the hook now tracks whether any job was actually admitted and returns before touching node state when none was; and enqueue itself calls clearNodeQueuedMarker on the rejection branch, so a rejected click is side-effect-free even for a caller that ignores the return value. Contract now: rejection implies the node's UI state is unchanged and server state stays consistent (queued means the node genuinely has an active job). FINDING 3 (guard was canvas-blind): hasActiveJobForNode and batchChains keyed on nodeId only while duplicateCanvas preserves node.id, so a legitimate generation on the duplicated canvas was silently rejected. Fix: guardScopeKey(canvasId, nodeId) now keys both the active-job check and the batch chain, and the active-job comparison requires (job.canvasId ?? null) === canvasId so null never cross-talks with a real canvas id. LOW-4 (latent batch-chain desync and unbounded growth): batchChains is now pruned on batch completion, on the single-shot/retry branch, after delivery when the scope has no active jobs, and on rejection. The rejection-branch clear was the real closure: it was measurably required, because with only the completion-branch prune the reviewer probe still admitted 3 extra jobs. Validating worker evidence: gate 6/6 PASS exit 0 and tsc --noEmit exit 0; the worker correctly states the gate is NOT evidence for these findings since it was already 6/6 before the repair and asserts only the flowStore copy without ever running App setNodes. Manager independent verification with the SAME untouched reviewer probes that had reproduced the defects (manager's own pre-repair copy, pointing at the live tree): probe-req001-coldstart now reports canvasStore data.queued=false and canRun=true with RESULT '节点可用（REQ-001 已修复）' (was locked), probe-lock-via-ui now reports queued=false/canRun=true and RESULT '未形成永久锁' (was '节点被永久锁死'), probe-cross-canvas now reports X=2 Y=2 and RESULT '两画布互不干扰' (was Y=0), probe-batch-chain 15/15 PASS, probe-ignored-rejection '标记被后续任务清除', probe-gate-caseA-fidelity '节点可用', probe-restart-final '节点可用', probe-req001-race '节点可用'. NOTE for the next reviewer: the manager identified one residual concern that the probes do NOT cover - clearNodeQueuedMarker is called on the rejection branch and on recovery clears the marker on the active canvas by falling back to activeCanvasId when canvasId is null, so a rejected click on a node having a legitimately still-queued job in the same scope could in principle clear a marker that another call had just set; the worker argues server state remains consistent because a rejected call can only happen when that scope already has an active job, but this interaction is asserted only by reasoning and should be attacked directly. Also probe-batch-chain scenario 14 observes that batchChains is a module-level Map with no size cap (500 nodes leave 500 chains), reported by the probe as an observation rather than a failure. Independent review by a FRESH reviewer context is still pending and is NOT claimed here; candidate digest will be bound by the tool from the current snapshot.
